scope: Expose EcocreditService cursor pagination in the TypeScript SDK

contract.request: Optional GrpcPageRequest.limit and offset are forwarded using the proto PageRequest shape.
contract.response: List response types model pagination.next_key and pagination.total as optional proto-loader keepCase fields.
contract.compatibility: Existing calls without a pagination argument preserve their prior request shape.

verification.typescript_vitest: 25 passed, including cursor forwarding and no-pagination compatibility for all nine methods
verification.server_source_review: Python gRPC list handlers ignore pagination requests and do not return page metadata

limitations: The change verifies SDK request wiring and typing only; runtime pagination remains unimplemented in the Python gRPC service.
The checks do not verify server pagination semantics or live transport.
Authentication, tenant isolation, TLS, and REST parity remain unassessed; CAP-064 remains open.
